description: Climate Change Indicator Platform is a decision-support tool listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USGCRP, U.S. Global Change Research Program. Eighteen climate indicators show trends over time in key aspects of our environment. These indicators provide foundational science in support of the U.S. Global Change Research Program's National Climate Assessment. They show examples from federal agency-specific indicator efforts, and connect federal agency research and science to USGCRP priorities. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Air Quality, Changing Seasons, Extreme Cold, Extreme Heat, Flooding – Rainfall-induced, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Water Quality. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Aquatic and Marine Resources, Economy, Energy and Utilities, Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property, Urban Landscape and Tree Canopy. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
